objective: Retry estrecho de R93 tras bloqueo transitorio de fetch/ref Git. Procesar 130MID del 2026-09-01 al 2026-09-12 inclusive, omitiendo dias ya reconciliados y dias sin Runtime. Escribir solo reparaciones seguras del detalle canonico. Nunca tocar Produccion.

queries.name: postcheck_130mid_202609
queries.sql: WITH rt AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) ventas_runtime,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets_runtime,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax_runtime FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)>='2026-09-01' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)<'2026-09-13' GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)), dt_ticket AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,numero_ticket,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) venta_ticket,MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)>='2026-09-01' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)<'2026-09-13' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date),numero_ticket), dt AS (SELECT fecha,SUM(venta_ticket) ventas_detalle,COUNT(*) tickets_detalle,SUM(pax_ticket) pax_detalle FROM dt_ticket GROUP BY fecha) SELECT TOP (200) rt.fecha,rt.ventas_runtime,ISNULL(dt.ventas_detalle,0) ventas_detalle,rt.tickets_runtime,ISNULL(dt.tickets_detalle,0) tickets_detalle,rt.pax_runtime,ISNULL(dt.pax_detalle,0) pax_detalle,CASE WHEN ABS(rt.ventas_runtime-ISNULL(dt.ventas_detalle,0))<=0.05 AND rt.tickets_runtime=ISNULL(dt.tickets_detalle,0) AND rt.pax_runtime=ISNULL(dt.pax_detalle,0) THEN 'OK' ELSE 'PENDIENTE' END estado FROM rt LEFT JOIN dt ON dt.fecha=rt.fecha ORDER BY rt.fecha
